description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis displays the reasoning categories: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Spatial Reasoning, Puzzle Solving, and Chemical Reasoning, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10⁴, with tick labels at intervals of powers of 10 (1, 10², 10³, 10⁴). Six light blue bars represent the number of samples for each category; the tallest bar corresponds to “Mathematical Reasoning” with a value of 7025, while the shortest bar represents “Chemical Reasoning” with a value of 49. The bar for “General Reasoning” has a value of 1709, “Natural Scene Reasoning” is at 413, “Spatial Reasoning” is at 232, and “Puzzle Solving” is at 91. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged in descending order based on their height.
